title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Int.dvd_mul_gcd_iff_dvd_mul
statement: The proposition declared as `Int.dvd_mul_gcd_iff_dvd_mul` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {k n m : ℤ}, k ∣ n * ↑(k.gcd m) ↔ k ∣ n * m
